Events linked to oncology/treatment episodes

Source: R/lang_v2.R
omop_episode_members.Rd

An event source whose rows are the events linked to the episodes of episode (an omop_event("episode", ...)) through episode_event, using the package's reviewed field-concept mapping. The same event linked to two episodes yields two rows.

Usage

omop_episode_members(
  episode,
  tables = NULL,
  where = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  on_missing_table = "error"
)

Arguments

episode

An omop_event over the episode table (or its name).

tables

Optional member tables to keep (default: every mapped table).

where

Optional row predicate over the member rows.

name

Event name.

on_missing_table

"error" or "unavailable".

Value

An omop_event object (adapter kind episode_members).
